description: Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.

d.request: Match constructor standings to races by raceId, keep entries with season-to-date points greater than or equal to 6.0, group by race name across years, and return each race name with the unrounded average season-to-date win count, ignoring missing wins and leaving the average missing when none are present.
d.sql:
SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
FROM constructorStandings AS cs
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
WHERE cs.points >= 6.0
GROUP BY r.name;

b.request: Match constructor standings entries to their races, include entries with season-to-date points greater than or equal to 6.0, group them by race name across all years, and return each race name with the unrounded average of non-missing season-to-date win counts, leaving the average missing when no values are available.
b.sql:
SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_season_to_date_wins
FROM constructorStandings AS cs
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
WHERE cs.points >= 6.0
GROUP BY r.name;
b.raw: Match constructor standings entries to their races, include entries with season-to-date points greater than or equal to 6.0, group them by race name across all years, and return each race name with the unrounded average of non-missing season-to-date win counts, leaving the average missing when no values are available.

c.request: Matching each constructor standings entry to its race (`races.raceId` = `constructorStandings.raceId`), keep only entries whose season-to-date championship points (`constructorStandings.points`) clear the 6.0-point threshold. Group the kept entries by race name (`races.name`, so same-named races from different years are combined), and for each race name return the name and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values and leaving the average missing if there are none, without rounding. Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.
c.sql:
SELECT races.name, AVG(constructorStandings.wins) AS average_wins
FROM constructorStandings
JOIN races ON races.raceId = constructorStandings.raceId
WHERE constructorStandings.points >= 6.0
GROUP BY races.name;

a.request: Matching each constructor standings entry to its race (`races.raceId` = `constructorStandings.raceId`), keep only entries whose season-to-date championship points (`constructorStandings.points`) are at least 6.0. Group the kept entries by race name (`races.name`, so same-named races from different years are combined), and for each race name return the name and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values and leaving the average missing if there are none, without rounding.
a.sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId WHERE cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY r.name;
